question: Why does deduplicating hShared not justify losing Team A, and which records/texts belong in the release output?

criteria.instruction: D22 permits one shared notice text by digest but keeps alder/Team A and birch/Team B as separate selected component attributions with their own origins/versions. Selected cedar/Team C and hC also belong once valid. Unselected build tool spruce and hS do not belong. v15 incorrectly stores complete component records keyed only by text digest and scans installed rather than selected components.
Join D22 per-component/dedup rules, inventory selection and packager overwrite behavior.
Do not equate shared text or origin identity with satisfied obligations or permission to omit an attribution.
